+def verify_manifest(existing, current_assets, current_pages):
+    print("Verifying site integrity against manifest...")
+    old_assets = existing.get("assets", {})
+    old_pages = existing.get("pages", {})
+    
+    mismatches = []
+    missing = []
+    
+    # Verify assets
+    for path, record in old_assets.items():
+        if path not in current_assets:
+            missing.append(f"Asset missing: {path}")
+        else:
+            current_hash = current_assets[path]
+            expected_hash = record if isinstance(record, str) else record.get("hash")
+            if current_hash != expected_hash:
+                mismatches.append(f"Asset hash mismatch: {path}")
+                
+    # Verify pages
+    for path, record in old_pages.items():
+        if path not in current_pages:
+            missing.append(f"Page missing: {path}")
+        else:
+            current_hash = current_pages[path]
+            expected_hash = record if isinstance(record, str) else record.get("hash")
+            if current_hash != expected_hash:
+                mismatches.append(f"Page content mismatch (body text changed): {path}")
+                
+    # Check for untracked new files
+    for path in current_assets:
+        if path not in old_assets:
+            print(f"  [NEW] Untracked asset: {path}")
+    for path in current_pages:
+        if path not in old_pages:
+            print(f"  [NEW] Untracked page: {path}")
+
+    if not mismatches and not missing:
+        print("\nSUCCESS: All tracked assets and pages match the integrity manifest.")
+        return True
+    else:
+        print("\nFAILURE: Integrity discrepancies detected!")
+        for m in missing: print(f"  [MISSING] {m}")
+        for m in mismatches: print(f"  [MISMATCH] {m}")
+        return False
+
+
 def main():
+    verify_mode = "--verify" in sys.argv

+        current_pages = collect_pages()

+        success = verify_manifest(existing, current_assets, current_pages)
+        sys.exit(0 if success else 1)

+class Tenet5HTMLParser(HTMLParser):
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.links = []

+    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
+        self.current_tag = tag
+        attr_dict = dict(attrs)
+
+        if "id" in attr_dict:
+            self.ids.add(attr_dict["id"])
+        
+        if tag == "html":
+            if "lang" not in attr_dict:
+                self.a11y_issues.append("Missing lang attribute on <html>")
+            else:
+                self.has_lang = True
+
+        if tag == "title":
+            self.has_title = True
+
+        # Link checking
+        if tag == "a" and "href" in attr_dict:
+            self.links.append(attr_dict["href"])
+
+        # Asset checking
+        if tag == "script" and "src" in attr_dict:
+            self.assets.append(attr_dict["src"])
+            self.in_script = True
+        elif tag == "script":
+            self.in_script = True
+
+        if tag == "link" and "href" in attr_dict:
+            # Check for stylesheets or icons
+            rel = attr_dict.get("rel", "").lower()
+            if "stylesheet" in rel or "icon" in rel:
+                self.assets.append(attr_dict["href"])
+
+        if tag == "img" and "src" in attr_dict:
+            self.assets.append(attr_dict["src"])
+            if "alt" not in attr_dict:
+                self.a11y_issues.append(f"Missing alt attribute on <img>: {attr_dict['src']}")
+
+        # Narration checking
+        if tag in ["section", "h2"]:
+            if "data-narrate" not in attr_dict:
+                self.narrations_missing.append(f"Missing data-narrate on <{tag}>")
+
+    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
+        if tag == "script":
+            self.in_script = False
+        self.current_tag = None
+
+    def handle_data(self, data):

+def check_path_exists(current_page_path, target):
+    if target.startswith(("http://", "https://", "mailto:", "tel:", "data:", "#")):
+        return True
+    
+    # Hallucination check

+
+    # Strip URL fragments and query params

+    if not clean_target:
+        return True
+    
+    target_path = (current_page_path.parent / clean_target).resolve()
+    try:
+        return target_path.exists() and SITE_ROOT in target_path.parents or target_path == SITE_ROOT
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
